name: Gianmarco Mazzocchi
bio: Gianmarco Mazzocchi is a global leader in AI economics and policy strategy. After a career spanning investment banking in Frankfurt and consulting across the Middle East, he built the AI Economics Unit at Whiteshield from the ground up. He leads a team that uses machine learning and unconventional data to advise governments on macroeconomic strategy and public policy, and recently launched the Global Labour Resilience Index at the World Economic Forum in Davos.
